question.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x) = P(X \leq x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(6) & =P(X\le 6) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,…,6\}) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,2\})+P(X\in \{3,4,5,6\}) \\  & =P(X\le 2)+P(3\le X\le 6) \\  & =F(2)+P(3\le X\le 6).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(3\le X\le 6) & =F(6)-F(2) \\  & =0.3134-0.0138 \\  & =0.2996.\end{aligned}
$$
